digest.component_or_area: JiraConfig validation in rebar configuration schema
propositions: JiraConfig accepts non-https (http://) jira.url without validation, risking cleartext credential exposure
DC's ReconcilerConfig validates scheme via _validate_reconciler_tls and raises ConfigError; Cloud's JiraConfig has no equivalent __post_init__ validation
ConfigError from load_config().jira is silently swallowed by three consumers (resolve_jira_settings, _jira_onboard._detect, write_jira_config), preventing fail-loud rejection at config load time
write_jira_config persists jira.url without scheme validation, allowing the onboarding wizard to silently write cleartext urls to disk

Solution requires generalized _validate_https_url helper, JiraConfig.allow_insecure field with __post_init__, and fail-loud enforcement in resolve_jira_settings and write_jira_config to match DC's posture
